function.name: musical_scale
function.description: Get the musical scale of a specific key in music theory. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

key.description: The musical key for which the scale will be found.

message.content:
C# 大調（C♯ major）的音階由七個音符組成，按音程順序為：

| 音階位置 | 音符 | 音程 |
|----------|------|------|
| 1        | C♯   | 根音 |
| 2        | D♯   | 大二度 |
| 3        | E♯   | 大三度 |
| 4        | F♯   | 完全四度 |
| 5        | G♯   | 完全五度 |
| 6        | A♯   | 大六度 |
| 7        | B♯   | 大七度 |
| 8        | C♯   | 八度 |

> **備註**  
> - E♯ 在音高上等同於 F，B♯ 等同於 C。  
> - 這些音符在鍵盤上對應於：C♯、D♯、F、F♯、G♯、A♯、C、C♯（如果你想用更直觀的名稱，也可以寫成 C♯、D♯、F、F♯、G♯、A♯、C、C♯）。  

這就是 C# 大調的完整音階。
message.reasoning: The user asks: "C#大調的音階是什麼？" They want the C# major scale. We can answer: C#, D#, E#, F#, G#, A#, B#, C#. But we might also mention enharmonic equivalents: C#, D#, E, F#, G#, A#, B, C#. But the standard major scale: C#, D#, E#, F#, G#, A#, B#, C#. In C# major, the notes are: C#, D#, E#, F#, G#, A#, B#, C#. But E# is enharmonic to F, B# enharmonic to C. So the scale: C#, D#, E#, F#, G#, A#, B#, C#. Provide explanation. No function needed.
